# spectral.rabi_freq { #clerq.spectral.rabi_freq }

```python
spectral.rabi_freq(solver, field_idx, *, window=None)
```

Fourier transform of the field result of field index.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type              | Description                                                                                                                                                                                              | Default    |
|-----------|-------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| solver    | PropagationSolver | A PropagationSolver object.                                                                                                                                                                              | _required_ |
| field_idx | int               | Field to return FFT of.                                                                                                                                                                                  | _required_ |
| window    | str \| None       | Optional SciPy window name (e.g. ``'hann'``, ``'blackman'``) applied to the time axis before the FFT to reduce spectral leakage. ``None`` (default) applies no windowing and does not change the result. | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type       | Description                                                              |
|--------|------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | np.ndarray | Array[num_z_steps, num_t_steps] Field result in frequency domain, of the |
|        | np.ndarray | *angular* field (``2 * pi`` times the cyclic ``rabi_freqs_zt``).         |
